description: This file defines the 'SubPanelTiles' class, which manages the display and behavior of subpanels in the SuiteCRM user interface. It includes methods for retrieving tabs, handling user preferences, rendering subpanels, and managing subpanel buttons and checkboxes.

classes.name: SubPanelTiles
classes.description: Manages rendering, tab selection, and user preferences for subpanels within SuiteCRM's user interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SubPanelTiles instance with focus object, layout key, and override.

methods.name: getSelectedGroup
methods.description: Determines the currently selected subpanel tab group based on user request, cookies, session, and defaults.

methods.name: getTabs
methods.description: Retrieves available subpanel tabs, applies user customizations, and optionally renders the tab display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the subpanel tiles, including tabs, subpanel contents, and control buttons.

methods.name: getLayoutManager
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the layout manager.

methods.name: get_buttons
methods.description: Generates HTML for action buttons in a subpanel, using the layout manager.

methods.name: getCheckbox
methods.description: Returns HTML including a checkbox for selecting subpanel items, optionally including a top link.
